messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please go back to the video from before the first action change was made, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still in profile, then raises both arms overhead and spins in place, ending back in a standing profile pose.","camera":"Static medium-full shot at roughly eye level, framing the character from head to feet against the storefront.","clothing":"White long-sleeve button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, dark suspenders, and a light checkered (plaid) pair of trousers with black shoes.","hair_color":"White / platinum.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair with a side part.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a medium-brown complexion, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"A cobblestone street in front of a dark storefront with a window reading 'SOAP' and a sign reading 'APOTHECARY', with a black lamppost to the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a sunny roadside with trees, rocks, and a guardrail to a cobblestone street in front of a dark apothecary storefront with a lamppost, matching the reference. The character's white hair, white shirt, suspenders, plaid trousers, black shoes, standing/spinning action, and static full-body framing were largely preserved. The lighting on the character became flatter and less strongly directional than in the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original roadside scene with the reference apothecary storefront environment while keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement unchanged, and adapt the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the character's identity and facial expression were preserved exactly, since close-up frames show some apparent facial differences.
unexpected_changes: The character's face appears slightly different in close-up frames, with a more defined jaw and facial features than in the source.
